description: Reyne, Baptiste and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The deposit supports a study of the thermomechanical viability of aluminium-reinforced concrete. Native descriptors identify plane-strain, plane-stress and curing-beam cases, with Abaqus base models, Isight or Python automation and resulting figure/data material. This is a structural-material simulation collection with explicit computational inputs and outputs. The actual material parameters, mesh convergence and structural design limits are not established by the brief description and are not inferred from archive names. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
